SELECT
  sumIf(Amount, ScenarioKey = 1) AS ActualSales,
  sumIf(Amount, ScenarioKey = 3) AS ForecastSales,
  sumIf(Amount, ScenarioKey = 1) - sumIf(Amount, ScenarioKey = 3) AS Variance,
  (sumIf(Amount, ScenarioKey = 1) - sumIf(Amount, ScenarioKey = 3)) * 100.0 / nullif(sumIf(Amount, ScenarioKey = 3), 0) AS VariancePercent,
  100.0 - abs(sumIf(Amount, ScenarioKey = 1) - sumIf(Amount, ScenarioKey = 3)) * 100.0 / nullif(sumIf(Amount, ScenarioKey = 3), 0) AS ForecastAccuracyPercent
FROM retail.FactStrategyPlan
WHERE AccountKey = 50
  AND ScenarioKey IN (1, 3)
  AND toYear(DateKey) = 2009
  AND toQuarter(DateKey) = 4
